//: The C code compiled into mqvpn (docs/sbom.md). syft can't see it: it is
linked statically, with no package metadata in the binary. Hand-maintained;
the versions are not: scripts/sbom/sbom.py reads them from the pinned
submodule commits and the sources at build time, and fails when it can't.
Every directory under third_party/mqvpn/third_party must be listed here or
in notShipped (sbom.py components checks it), so a new library can't
slip into a release unlisted. libevent is not here: its version comes from

notShipped.third_party/mqvpn/third_party/wintun: Windows driver; tailbond ships no Windows build

components.name: xquic
components.comment: mqvpn's fork of https://github.com/alibaba/xquic (branch mqvpn-main); no upstream release version applies.

components.name: boringssl
components.comment: Pinned by commit; BoringSSL has no stable releases, so scanners can't match it by version.

components.name: lwip
components.comment: heiher's lwIP fork (hev-socks5-tunnel) as forked for mqvpn's TCP lane.

components.name: yyjson
components.comment: Vendored source files in mqvpn (not a submodule).
